data.comment:
# Comfy 1 Click Multiple Character Angles

Upload an image of your character and get multiple views of that image from different angles Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates-1_click_multiple_character_angles-v1.0.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
